title: Mask and restrict ExportTool output files
description: In src/tools/mongodb/read/export.ts:68-98, wrap the find/aggregate cursor in a Transform stream that applies maskDocuments (task 2) before ExportsManager.createJSONExport (src/common/exportsManager.ts:157) writes the file. In createJSONExport, create export files with mode 0600 inside exportsPath. For namespaces classified pii or financial, stop returning the plain filesystem path from the isServerRunningLocally() branch (export.ts:131-133) and serve the data only through the resource URI. Lower the exportTimeoutMs default for classified exports so files are purged promptly; the userConfig override only allows lowering it. Keep the change in the same PR series as task 2 and do not change the find/aggregate argument schema.
acceptanceCriteria: An export of a seeded classified collection in dev produces a JSON file whose masked fields hold redacted values (checked by reading the file through the returned resource URI)
The export file created under exportsPath has permissions 0600 (stat -c %a <file> prints 600)
For a classified namespace on stdio transport, the tool response contains a resource_link and no text item with the local exportPath
A probe-schemas re-run no longer reports SCH-API-03 at src/tools/mongodb/read/export.ts

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit. Expected result: no SCH-API-03 fail result for export.ts, and fingerprint 1811d886... is absent from the SARIF export.

rootCause.description: ExportTool streams the unfiltered cursor to a world-readable local JSON file and exposes its path, with no masking and only best-effort TTL cleanup.
